paragraphs: He is mentioned at the end of halakhah 3 in Kilayim, chapter 9, as having made shoes for R' Zeira.[^1][^2]

notes.text: סה״ג is conventionally read as end of halakhah3, replacing the old unresolved placeholder. Chapter9 remains explicit; the Jerusalem Talmud suggestion has not been independently verified against a named edition.
Zeira’s title is abbreviated and retained as R', restoring the old neutral form. Bar Rishon made shoes for Zeira, not the reverse; no further Zeira identity is bound.
